backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the QuickRepair backend with user registration/profile management, feedback submission and retrieval, and admin-only operations (list users, delete users/feedback), protected by an access control mixin.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts the old feedback store (without IDs) to a new format with auto-incremented IDs and initializes a new userStore and feedbackCounter for the upgraded actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (Internet Identity auth UI, ProfileModal, AdminPage) to their source files, component dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes used throughout the shadcn-ui component system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the QuickRepair app including Google Search Console verification, LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, and preconnect/dns-prefetch hints for ICP and Internet Identity endpoints.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up React Query, implements pathname-based routing to render AdminPage at /admin or the full main site with lazy-loaded sections and floating action buttons elsewhere.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a text description of QuickRepair and a 2x2 grid of highlight cards (response time, verified professionals, transparent pricing, local coverage) using a fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that fetches and displays all users and feedback entries, with delete actions for each, and shows access-denied or loading states based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Renders the contact section with clickable phone, email, and working-hours cards, a WhatsApp booking button, and a list of service areas served by QuickRepair.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Displays an accordion-style FAQ section with nine predefined questions and answers about QuickRepair's services, pricing, and coverage, toggling open/closed on click.
Shows customer reviews (combining live canister data with sample reviews), an average star rating, and a form for authenticated users to submit new star-rated feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed floating button in the bottom-right corner that links to the QuickRepair phone number with a gradient phone icon and a 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link to book a QuickRepair service.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with the QuickRepair logo, smooth-scroll nav links, a WhatsApp booking button, copyright info, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with scroll-aware styling, Internet Identity login/logout, a user profile dropdown, and a mobile hamburger menu that opens a NavigationDrawer.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, animated fade-in headline, tagline, and WhatsApp CTA buttons promoting QuickRepair's 10-minute doorstep service.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section (Book → Mechanic Arrives → Problem Solved) with icon circles, connector lines, and a fade-in animation using the useFadeIn hook.
frontend/src/components/LanguagePopup.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: Slide-in mobile navigation drawer with scroll-spy active state highlighting, section links, a 'Become a Mechanic' WhatsApp link, and a footer phone number.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: Semi-transparent blurred backdrop overlay component used to dim content behind the mobile navigation drawer.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: Modal form for new authenticated users to complete their profile by entering name, phone, and selecting a service area, then submitting via the useRegisterUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Renders a clickable service card that links to a WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message, displaying an icon, service name, description, starting price, and a 'Book' button.
Displays a grid of service cards (plumber, electrician, fan/cooler, AC, mechanic) with a section header and a fallback WhatsApp CTA for users unsure which service they need.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: Renders a horizontal stats bar showing three trust indicators—happy customers, response time, and star rating—with fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling CSS fade-in transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating feedback, average ratings, feedback count, user profiles, and admin status against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks the currently visible section by comparing scroll position against section offsets, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for the dark theme and brand colors, Tailwind utility extensions, keyframe animations, and reusable component styles like fade-in and service card hover effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers for sensitive values like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a dark-themed design system with brand colors (yellow/orange/green), custom shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot for QuickRepair, a Delhi home repair service site, documenting version 19 features including pricing, WhatsApp integration, Internet Identity auth, admin panel, and architectural constraints.
